verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit runs several configurable automations in the background. Reviews trigger automatically on PR open and can be tuned by branch, label, draft status or commit count. It also auto-analyzes CI/CD failures, flags slop PRs, syncs request-changes/approval decisions, keeps a self-updating Triage queue, and sends scheduled Slack digests. These automations are fixed to the review domain and configured through YAML; there is no evidence of general user-defined automations. Finishing-touch custom recipes are one-click actions, not autonomous ones. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-authored automations with custom triggers or schedules, autonomous (unprompted) agentic fix/recipe runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of background automation behavior.
